I'm... I'm really back to Navida!\nBut this winter is snowing more than usual...\nHalf of the city is under the snow...
No... It's not snow.\nThe whole city is frozen!!
What?!
Beside that... The decorations such as fir trees\nand wreaths to collect Xmas energy are all gone...\nWhat's going on here...
Oh, you're back! Hm? Well, we've tried hard to\nbreak the ice that is blocking the way to the\ncity with Baina but we couldn't...
I'm ashamed to say this but we haven't found the\n3 knights yet... Hm? The people on your back...\nThey are...!
Been a while, commander Agios!\nI heard it from the adventurer and came to help\nyou guys!!
I was also trapped in the monster's ice cage.\nSo, I know it can't be broken with weapons.
We had no choice but to melt with heat.\nThe adventurer was trying to save people in the\nice with Burning Liquid, so...
We thought the Burning Liquid can melt the ice\nblocking our way not only the frozen people.\nSo, we collected it.
Let's melt the ice and go to help your subordinates\nand townspeople!
Gosh! We had a hard time dealing with the ice\nbut it's gone in a blink... Mr. Tenert, and the\ncaravan members. I can't thank you enough...
Leave that aside. We've gotta save your fellows\nfrom the ice first! Now, let's go!!
Right! Baina, guide us to there!!
Yes, sir!
Are you alright?!
Sir Agios?! I'm sorry, sir!\nWe couldn't stop this...
The monster is too strong.\nWe must unite to defeat it.\nDo you understand?
Yes, sir!
All the elite Xmas knights are here!! Great!\nGo to the square now and defeat the monster!!
Wait! Calm down!
You can't beat Baphomela.\nWe need the great spirit's power...
But Xmas energy isn't back in Navida, so the great\nspirit cannot wake up from sleep. We need to refill\nthe Xmas energy in the city first...
Then I'll collect it from now...
Hey! What kind of commander are you?!\nThe knights have been released from the ice with\nevil power just now and they're still exhausted...
Right. Nothing goes well while we're exhausted.\nYou're tired, too right? Why not take a break?
Well, a leader doesn't care about his subordinates.\nI just don't get it. Why not care about 'em?
How can I care for a subordinate who always\ntries to goof off?!
Well. The adventurer and caravan members need a\nrest. Let's restore our energy to wake up the\ngreat spirit.
